title: Herb Garden in Upcycled Ceramic Cup

steps.text: Wash and dry the ceramic vessel thoroughly.
Layer pebbles across the bottom for root drainage.
Add potting soil until the container is two-thirds full.
Nestle the herb seedling carefully into the center and tamp gently.
Water lightly and attach a handwritten care label.

title: Aromatic Coffee & Beeswax Candle

materials.name: Natural soy wax or beeswax flakes

steps.text: Glue the wick tab to the center bottom of your clean glass jar.
Gently melt the wax in a heat-safe bowl over simmering water.
Stir in a handful of whole roasted coffee beans as wax reaches liquid state.
Carefully pour warm wax into the jar, keeping the wick upright.
Allow to cool for 3 hours before trimming wick to 5mm.

safety: Adult supervision recommended for hot wax melting and pouring.
